summary: Rigetti Computing filed an 8-K disclosing a September 4, 2026 Other Transaction Agreement between its subsidiary Rigetti Co, LLC and the U.S. Department of Commerce under the CHIPS Act of 2022, awarding up to $100 million for superconducting quantum R&D. The award funds three project tasks — readout electronics miniaturization, advanced cryostat architecture, and high-connectivity chip fabrication. Tranches include $43.9 million available at award date, then $29.9 million and $26.2 million contingent on Department discretion and milestone completion. Term runs to the earlier of milestone completion or the fifth anniversary. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms stated.
